metadata.description: Manovella: product promo and release films written as code, and the Studio that briefs them.

plugins.name: manovella
plugins.description: Product promo and release films written as code: one canvas whose every frame is a pure seek(t), captured in headless Chrome with real motion blur and loops exact to the pixel; the product's UI rebuilt as vector; release films built from a tag; and the Studio, a window where recipe, format, look and sound are chosen on live previews.
